svg.title: Azure Files with Microsoft Entra sign-in
svg.desc: Step 1: testuser1 signs in to the VM vm-azb-win01, which asks Microsoft Entra ID for a Kerberos ticket for the storage account. Step 2: Entra ID returns the ticket. Step 3: the VM mounts the file share azbshare in the storage account over SMB on port 445. The role Storage File Data SMB Share Contributor, given to the group TestUsers on the share, decides what the user may do. The Conditional Access box shows that no MFA policy may cover the storage account app, or the mount fails with error 1327. Entra ID and the users belong to the tenant. The VM and the storage account are in rg-azb-lab.
svg.text: Azure subscription and its Microsoft Entra tenant
No MFA on the storage account app
